caption: The drawing depicts a round pan or shallow dish viewed from above, rendered in grayscale pencil or charcoal on beige-colored paper. The pan has a circular body with concentric shading to indicate its depth and spherical contour, and it features a tab-like handle at the top center, which has a rounded shape with a hole for hanging. The handle appears to be an extension of the circular form, curving outward with a distinct outline. The composition is centered within a rectangular border drawn lightly on the paper. In the bottom left corner, there is a separate, smaller inset drawing showing a side profile of the pan, including the handle and an indication of its depth and overall length, annotated with the measurements "1 1/2 in" for height and "5 1/4 in" for diameter. The shading is darkest along the outer rim of the pan and gradually lightens towards the center, providing a sense of three-dimensionality. The artist's signature, "R. ZADENBERG," appears at the bottom right of the primary drawing.
title: Pewter Porringer
